name: AWS tag orphan cleanup
__comment__: AWSTag nodes are keyed by Key:Value and shared across accounts, so they have no sub resource to scope a node cleanup to. This job runs once after every account has loaded and linked its tags, so a tag that no relationship uses is an orphan even if this sync wrote it.

statements.query: MATCH (n:AWSTag) WHERE NOT (n)--() WITH n LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE DETACH DELETE n RETURN COUNT(*) AS TotalCompleted
